# Empowr — Start Here

> start.empowrcic.org is the primary entry point for discovering everything Empowr CIC offers — its mission, programmes, platforms, and ways to get involved.

This single-page landing site connects new visitors to the right part of the Empowr ecosystem: whether they are looking to join a programme, support the mission, hire a freelancer, or learn more about the organisation.

## Where to Go

- [EELA](https://eela.empowrcic.org): Find and book learning and development sessions
- [EFN](https://efn.empowrcic.org): Join or hire through the Empowr Freelancer Network
- [Empowr Heroes](https://hero.empowrcic.org): Donate and support Empowr CIC's community programmes
- [Empowr CIC](https://empowrcic.org): Learn about the organisation, its mission, and its programmes

## About

Operated by Empowr CIC (empowrcic.org), a UK-based Community Interest Company focused on empowering individuals through education, employment, and community connection.

## Contact

- Website: https://start.empowrcic.org
- Parent organisation: https://empowrcic.org
